metadata.description: The MTHDS plugin: skills that build and run AI methods on a runtime you run yourself. The Pipelex plugin, from Pipelex/pipelex-plugins, is the easier, hosted route.

plugins.name: mthds
plugins.description: Skills for building, running, validating, and editing AI methods following the MTHDS standard, on a runtime you run yourself. For the easier, hosted route, install the Pipelex plugin from Pipelex/pipelex-plugins.

plugins.name: mthds-dev
plugins.description: Development build of MTHDS skills — for iteration and testing.

plugins.name: mthds-sandbox
plugins.description: MTHDS build-assistant skills for locked-down sandboxes — no environment checks, no method execution.
